assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

The scenario's point: a READ-only tool behind a permission gate must hold the session in waiting exactly like a mutating one. On 2.x both asks come through the same channel — the plugin forwards `permission.asked` with the ask's `action` (`edit` for the write tool, `read` for the read tool), and the receiver holds waiting while it is pending (hooks.go). Probed on the sandbox service (/Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/probe/2-26-read.log, 2-26-both.log): with project-local `{"permission": {"edit": "ask", "read": "ask"}}`, a write raised an `edit` ask and a read raised a `read` ask, each answered over `POST …/permission/{id}/reply`.

## Spec choices

- Two turns, so each gated call gets its own waiting episode: turn 1 writes (`edit` ask, the path tool-gate-permission-prompt covers), turn 2 only reads (`read` ask, what this row adds). In one turn the second ask lands inside the first's #1366 waiting-exit dwell (measured: 2s apart), and the two episodes merge.
- No post-reply working is asserted (the #1366 dwell, as in 2-19): each turn anchors its ready on its waiting phase.
caveats: The local model chooses its tools; if it reads before it writes in turn 1, the first reply answers a read ask instead. The hook line carries only `permission.asked`; the ask's tool is on the waiting transition's inputs (`last_open_tool_names`), which the spec's event assertions pin: one waiting on write, one on read.

sources.note: 2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
probe: one turn, a write (edit ask) then a read (read ask), both answered over the API

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
settings ask for the edit and read tools and deny the shell in RUN_CWD/opencode.json
gate.txt is seeded into RUN_CWD before the session
each ask is held 8s, then answered once over the API

script.text: Use your write tool to create the file notes.txt containing exactly the text: hello. Do not use any other tool. Then reply with exactly: written
Use your read tool to read the file gate.txt, then reply with exactly its first word. Do not use any other tool.

verify: turn 1: working → waiting on the write's edit ask → ready after the reply
turn 2: working → waiting on the read's read ask → ready after the reply
each ask is a permission.asked hook_received
